title: Amount of the Bluegate Moving Truck Rental Move-In Rental Waiver
content:
**Billing clause — the amount of the Bluegate Moving Truck Rental free move-in rental waiver.**

1. The waiver amount is the first-day rental fee posted on the contract — the base rental fee line dated the actual pickup date — as posted, credited in full.
2. The rental waiver is never figured on more than the first-day rental fee as posted, so a discount already given on that fee and the rental waiver together never exceed it.
3. The rental waiver credited is the smaller of the waiver amount and the balance the contract owes when the waiver is credited, which is the charges and refunds standing on the contract less the credits and payments already on it, rounded to the cent once at the end.

## Worked figures (hypothetical contracts)

| First-day rental fee posted on the actual pickup date | Charges and refunds on the contract | Credits and payments already on it | Balance owed | Rental waiver credited |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 26.96 | 140.10 | 0.00 | 140.10 | 26.96 |
| 26.96 | 140.10 | 128.10 | 12.00 | 12.00 — the balance is the smaller |
| 29.95 | 29.95 | 0.00 | 29.95 | 29.95 |

The first-day fee read is the fee as it was posted, already net of any discount given on it; nothing is added back to it.
